verdict.rationale: Missive ships AI features (an assistant, MCP, AI compose), so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no data-training policy, opt-out control, or statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Running the assistant on your own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key is an adjacent arrangement, not a documented training-prevention capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
